tips.text: Buy extra Stock relics; every one carries it as the Rare and it is the bottleneck.
Buy her relics from the Market console on your Orbiter to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Bank Aya before her window opens; neither Aya nor relics expire when her stock rotates.
Refine Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant and leave Common ones Intact, since Radiant lowers Common odds.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen so they earn 5 bonus Void Traces.
